title: Auditing Recorded Predictive Lead Service-Line Classifications Against Physical Verification: A Statewide Study of New York
abstract: arXiv:2608.19922v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Under the US Lead and Copper Rule Revisions, a utility may determine a service line's material with a predictive model instead of inspecting it. New York State publishes, per address, which method was used. Almost no address carries both a model classification and a physical verification, so the check is between populations within a utility rather than paired addresses. We screen all 153 New York localities that classified at least 100 addresses this way. Seventy-five (49%), covering 125,990 addresses or 57% of those screened, record one value. Zero variance alone is not misconduct: 68 of the 75 match their own verification or have too little to test. Seven are contradicted by their own crews, six beyond any sampling explanation. Five are boroughs of New York City, which file as one system; one is East Rochester, 550 km away. translated_title: 审计记录在案的预测性铅服务管线分类与物理验证的对比：纽约州全州研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：根据美国《铅铜规则修订版》，公用事业公司可以使用预测模型而非实际检查来确定服务管线的材质。纽约州按地址公布了所使用的判定方法。几乎没有地址同时具备模型分类和物理验证数据，因此检查是在公用事业公司内部的不同群体之间进行，而非逐地址配对比较。我们筛选了纽约州所有153个以这种方式对至少100个地址进行分类的地方。其中75个（49%）覆盖125,990个地址（占筛选地址的57%）记录了单一值。零方差本身并非不当行为：这75个中的68个与自身验证结果一致或数据量过少无法检验。有7个被自身工作人员的证据所反驳，其中6个无法用任何抽样解释说明。其中有5个是纽约市的行政区，它们作为一个系统申报；还有一个是东罗切斯特，距离550公里。纽约市是最大的案例：预测模型被记录为43,215个地址的判定依据，且在所有...
tldr: 本研究审计了纽约州153个地区的预测性铅服务管线分类记录，发现75个地区存在零方差记录，其中7个被自身验证证据反驳，尤其是纽约市作为最大案例，其预测模型记录覆盖43,215个地址且缺乏物理验证支持。
en_tdlr: This study audits predictive lead service-line classifications across 153 New York localities, finding zero-variance records in 75, with 7 contradicted by physical verification—most notably New York City, where predictive models cover 43,215 addresses without supporting physical checks.
